action.content: Write a very angry letter to someone who's been trying to convince you that 1+1=3. There should be exactly 4 paragraphs. Separate the paragraphs with ***.
action.label: context

action.content:
I am absolutely furious that you have the audacity to stand before me and claim that 1+1 equals 3, a statement so fundamentally broken it defies every law of mathematics known to humanity. You are not just wrong; you are actively mocking the very foundation of logic and reason, treating basic arithmetic as if it were a matter of personal opinion rather than an unchangeable truth. How dare you waste my time with such a blatant falsehood when the answer is so clearly, undeniably, and universally two!

***

Every time you open your mouth to argue this point, you strip away the dignity of intellectual discourse and replace it with a chaotic mess of nonsense that no sane person could possibly accept. You seem to believe that sheer repetition or loud insistence can alter the nature of numbers, but you are fighting a battle against reality itself, and reality does not bend to your delusions. It is insulting to my intelligence to even entertain the idea that you might have a valid point, because there is none to be found in your twisted reasoning.

***

I find it utterly exhausting to have to explain to you that adding one object to another single object results in a pair, not a trio, and yet you persist in this absurdity with a stubbornness that borders on the criminal. You are forcing me to confront the possibility that you have lost your mind or are simply playing a cruel joke on everyone around you, but the damage is done to the integrity of the conversation. No amount of patience on my part can fix the fact that you are spreading misinformation with the confidence of a liar who thinks they are the smartest person in the room.

***

Stop trying to convince me of this impossible equation immediately, because I am done listening to your ridiculous arguments and your complete disregard for factual accuracy. If you continue to push this agenda, I will have no choice but to cut you off entirely, as your presence in this discussion is nothing short of an insult to the concept of truth itself. Get out of my sight and never speak to me about math again, because I will not tolerate one more second of your delusional nonsense.||
